title: Visions of Havenhythe
start: Speak to the bartender at the Rusty Anchor Tavern in Port Sarim.

steps.t: Talk to the bartender at the Rusty Anchor tavern in Port Sarim. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Visions of Havenhythe' › Accept]
Drink the dragonfire mead.
After the cutscene, go downstairs via the door on the east side of the room.
Talk to the bartender. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Visions of Havenhythe']
Talk to 'Shady' Sullivan by the entrance of the tavern.
Talk to Captain Lorris on the Port Sarim docks just east of the lodestone. [Chat: 1 I'm ready.]
Talk to Old Man Jocko on the dock. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Visions of Havenhythe']
Head east towards the city of Wendlewick, then speak to Adam in the building north of the well in the centre of the village. [Chat: 2 What do we do now? (Continue Quest)]
Head south, past the lodestone and over the bridge, then south-east towards the Shrine of Inanna.
Talk to Shrine Tender Joanna.
Pray at the Altar of Inanna west of the summoning obelisk.
p: Praying at the Altar of Inanna

steps.t: Talk to Shrine Tender Joanna.
Return and talk to Adam.
Talk to Zeke in the building just south-east of Adam.
Head west to the beach and kill 10 juvenile boulder crab. Pick up the limestone they drop.

sub.t: You must kill the crabs, but you can bring your own limestone bricks to Zeke.

p: Meeting with them in front of the lodestone

steps.t: Return to Zeke.

sub.t: If you do not have level 12 Crafting, now it is time to give the limestone to Adam so that he can turn those limestone into bricks.
If you want to convert them yourself and have the skill to do it, you may do so now.

steps.t: Run south across the first bridge, through the lighthouse and out the back door. From the outside go up the stairs.
Talk to Esther.
Go back downstairs, walk north, and build at the Lodestone hotspot just across the river.
Quest complete!
